C2 [Nit] review-c: score-impact: no. The review page leaves important labels unexplained for a new reader. The current page shows two unnamed provisional pass-1 entries. pages/review.html:113-129 gives no class legend or definition of provisional. The reason also uses PM without an explanation. Show the route beside each pass. Define C1-C9 and provisional, and expand PM. This finding remains nonblocking under the PM cap.
